data.name: Realm Runners
data.detailed_description:
REALM RUNNERS IS A SINGLE-PLAYER ACTION RPG ROGUELITE WHERE BECOMING POWERFUL IS ONLY HALF THE PROBLEM — YOU STILL HAVE TO GET OUT ALIVE.

Enter a brutal tournament built by The Architect, an ancient AI promising one wish to the winner. Survive escalating enemy pressure, hunt valuable gear, shape a deadly build, and face bosses and Rival Runners fighting for the same prize.

Then make the choice at the heart of every run: extract with what you've earned, or push deeper for greater rewards and risk losing the gear that you worked hard for.

BUILD SOMETHING WORTH LOSING

Every item can change the direction of your run. Combine stats, randomized enchantments, and build-defining Aspects to turn your Runner into something more.

Aspects are powers bound to gear that grow stronger as you build around them and can evolve into more powerful forms. Chase better rolls, discover powerful synergies, and decide when your build is valuable enough to secure — or powerful enough to risk it.

THE WAVES TEST YOUR ENDURANCE. BOSSES TEST YOUR SKILL.

Fight through mounting enemy pressure with weighty combat built around movement, timing, positioning, and impact. A strong build can turn a swarm into dust instantly, but raw power won't carry you through everything.

Bosses and Rival Runners demand execution. Rival Runners aren't just another monster in the crowd, they are competitors with player-like movement and abilities, chasing the same prize you are.

EXTRACT OR GET GREEDY

The longer you stay, the more valuable your run can become and the more it hurts to die.

Take the route out and secure your loot. Or keep pushing into deadlier encounters, optional high-risk challenges, and greater rewards.

In Realm Runners, greed isn't just a feeling. It's a gameplay decision.

RETURN. REBUILD. GO AGAIN.

Back at the Hub, buy and sell gear, gamble for new items, reroll Attributes and Aspects, recover and replace some of what you've lost, and prepare for stronger attempt.

Every successful extraction gives you more ways to shape your Runner and more worth risking when you step back into the tournament.

ONE WISH. WHAT COULD GO WRONG?

The Architect claims the tournament was created to help living beings. Win, and you are promised one wish — anything you desire.

Every Runner enters with their own reason to believe that promise and their own story to uncover. But the deeper you push into the tournament, the harder it becomes to believe that The Architect's idea of “help” is one you should trust.

Build your Runner. Risk what you've earned. Know when to leave.

BUILD FAST. GET GOOD. EXTRACT BEFORE GREED GETS YOU KILLED.

data.short_description: Realm Runners is a single-player action RPG with extraction elements. Fight your way through a brutal dark sci-fi tournament for a chance to claim your one true wish. Loot gear, define your build and get good. Maybe then you'll stand a chance. Get greedy and you might die wishing.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 19043 or newer)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1300X or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon R7 260X / Intel UHD Graphics 630 (1 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required. 64-bit processor and operating system required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (7th generation) or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-compatible GPU with 1 GB VRAM (Intel Iris Plus Graphics 640 or better)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required. 64-bit processor and operating system required.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro / M2 or Intel Core i5-8400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal 2 compatible dedicated or integrated GPU (Apple M-series or AMD Radeon Pro 560X or better)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required.

content_descriptors.notes: Realm Runners contains frequent stylized pixel-art violence, blood, and gore in a dark sci-fi tournament setting. Players fight hostile creatures, bosses, and other Runners using melee and ranged weapons and combat abilities. Some environments may contain corpses and other violent imagery. The game's mature content is centered on violence and does not include sexual content or sexual violence.
